description: The Remove Duplicates dialog. Lists every column in the range with a checkbox, offers a "my data has headers" toggle (which switches the column labels between header text and the column letter), select-all / deselect-all helpers and a case-sensitivity option. Applying yields a SpreadsheetRemoveDuplicatesOptions. All text is localized.

parameters.name: HeaderLabels
parameters.description: Header text per absolute column index, used to label columns when my data has headers is on. Columns without an entry fall back to their column letter.

parameters.name: OnApply
parameters.description: Raised when the user applies the dialog.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog is dismissed.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTargetId
parameters.description: The id of the element focus returns to on close — the host spreadsheet passes its grid root so focus lands on the grid. Null falls back to the element focused before the dialog opened.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the dialog renders. Auto follows the viewport scope (a sheet on the narrow one); a forced value pins the mode without measuring, so a test can render the mobile sheet without a DOM.
